stage0076_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye, ma'am.
　We're currently at S26-05, W23-08.」

stage0076_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$ラー・カイラム$$, $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, and
　Ptolemaios 2 are moving as decoys, over
　open water 100km north of here.」

stage0076_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Neo Zeon is wary of our movements.
　With Japan's forces unable to move, it's
　on us to defend Dakar.」

stage0076_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This ship will carry $c's main force
　onward and make for Dakar.」

stage0076_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Still, it's odd.
　Supreme Command hasn't moved any units
　to Dakar, or so they say.」

stage0076_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...I received a report on that from
　Commander $$レディ・アン$$. Unofficially, the
　moderates, including the $$大統領$$, are gathering in Dakar.」

stage0076_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Supreme Command must mean to let the
　$$大統領$$ and the others die.」

stage0076_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Can't the moderates' meeting be called off?」

stage0076_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Unfortunately, fleeing Dakar now would
　only be more dangerous.」

stage0076_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「To protect the $$大統領$$ and the others, we
　must rush to Dakar and meet Neo Zeon
　head-on.」

stage0076_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Sonar contact...!
　It seems the enemy has come!」

stage0076_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, shift to battle stations!」

stage0076_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Zeon's amphibious mobile suit unit, is it.」

stage0076_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「$c, all units.
　This battle will be fought underwater.」

stage0076_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Units unsuited to this need not force a
　launch. Our objective is only to break
　through this sea zone. Keep launches minimal.」

stage0076_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The plan is as $$カリーニン$$ explained.
　Once the Danaan clears this sea zone,
　the win is ours.」

stage0076_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Sending target waypoints to all units.」

stage0076_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No unit needs to cover this ship.
　If anything, if you sense danger, land
　without hesitation.」

stage0076_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Even more confident than usual, aren't you.」

stage0076_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「There's no way the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$,
　built and commanded by me, would lose
　in the sea to a Spacenoid-made mobile suit.」

stage0076_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「As you say, Captain.」

stage0076_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カレン$$
「As always, $$テッサ$$ becomes a different
　person once the fighting starts.」

stage0076_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$マオ$$
「Naturally.
　After all, she's our commanding officer.」

stage0076_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$宗介$$
「And the enemy will be made to learn the
　meaning of the Captain's words, sick and
　tired of it, within a few minutes.」

stage0076_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$n
「We'd better be careful not to hold
　everyone back...」

stage0076_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, commence attack!
　Teach them what a real sea battle is!」

stage0076_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am!
　Commencing attack!」

stage0076_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「A group of units, coming from another
　direction!」

stage0076_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「No, these aren't mobile suits...!
　This is...!」

stage0076_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「They mean to strike both us and Neo
　Zeon at once...!」

stage0076_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$刹那$$
「No... it seems their target is only us.」

stage0076_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Now that's an honor!
　So they figure we're the bigger threat,
　is that it!」

stage0076_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Amalgam has joined hands with Geminis.
　And $$フル・フロンタル$$'s forces were
　operating jointly with Amalgam...）

stage0076_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, be careful.
　Geminis is targeting only us.」

stage0076_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Our objective is only to break through
　this sea zone. Don't forget that.」

stage0076_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Confirmed all enemy units destroyed.」

stage0076_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「We've reached the point.」

stage0076_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「We're breaking through this sea zone now!
　All units, withdraw at once!」

stage0076_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand what you want to say, $$ゼロ$$.」

stage0076_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Heh... it seems even someone like me
　has no role to play here.」

stage0076_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Confirmed all units have withdrawn.」

stage0076_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then, let's withdraw the
　$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ as well.」

stage0076_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「A pursuit force is coming.」

stage0076_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Geminis... still coming, are they.」

stage0076_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「So it's that position after all.」

stage0076_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$テッサ$$
「They probably think they've outmaneuvered us.」

stage0076_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$ゼロ$$, having read that coming, is quite
　an impressive man.」

stage0076_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then, since I've made my bold claim to
　him, let's handle this swiftly.」

stage0076_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Though, since we'd already read their
　position, this will be over in an instant.」

stage0076_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Let's go all out.
　Load torpedoes into every tube!」

stage0076_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am,
　loading torpedoes into tubes one through six.」

stage0076_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am, firing all torpedoes!」

stage0076_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This should make even those despicable,
　dim-witted fools understand who rules
　the sea.」

stage0076_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This ship will withdraw from this sea
　zone too. We'll recover $c's units at
　the rendezvous point, then head for Dakar.」

stage0076_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「If we ever lose to some amphibious
　jack-of-all-trades, I'll never sail again.」

stage0076_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Of course. So will I.」

stage0076_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Never arrogant, never careless, if we
　bring out the strength we've trained,
　we have no equal in this sea.」

stage0076_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's time to show the pride of a
　submariner. I expect everyone to rise
　to the occasion.」

stage0076_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$宗介$$
「As expected of the Captain's leadership.
　It gives us absolute peace of mind.」

stage0076_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アル$$
「She has complete control over allied
　forces unaccustomed to underwater combat.」

stage0076_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$宗介$$
「If we faithfully carry out the Captain's
　orders, we can win...! As long as the
　$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ stands, we won't lose!」

stage0076_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$マオ$$
「You've got some skill, $$テッサ$$.
　Well... search the whole world, and you
　still won't find anyone who beats her in the water.」

stage0076_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$マオ$$
「Guess us subordinates better get to
　work too! Never thought we'd be doing
　underwater combat in an AS, though!」

stage0076_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Even underwater, my aim is dead on
　every time!」

stage0076_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「A rare situation, this is!
　I'll show off in front of $$テッサ$$!」

stage0076_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Never thought we'd end up doing
　underwater combat in an AS...」

stage0076_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「But my skill doesn't care where I fight!
　I'll show a battle worthy of the
　$$ウルズ$$ 1 name!」

stage0076_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong, $n!?
　We trained for underwater combat in
　simulation, didn't we!」

stage0076_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$n
「It's just... $$弁慶$$, who trained with
　me for that, isn't here, and it's sad...」

stage0076_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$n
「Even though he always used to gripe
　about never getting a chance for
　underwater combat...」

stage0076_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$スズネ$$
「T-to repay $$弁慶$$ for that, too,
　we have to do our best!」

stage0076_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Even so, this underwater thing's a
　stretch...」
